dogecoin.text: @dogecoin_empire It doesn't hurt my manhood. I am on disability in my old age. She's the bread-winner, I take care of the house and yard to the best of my abilities and cook. She does the dishes.

@dogecoin_empire 1995 I am getting out of bed and putting on my uniform, getting to work, checking out a med-bag and starting a pre-shift checklist on an ambulance. That is if I wasn't asleep in the ambulance and got woke up by dispatch sending us on a call.
